hook: Hazard started as a game, and the stakes were real.
modernAnchor: A yellow sign, a wet floor, a flashing light. We call it a hazard.
journey: Arabic az-zahr meant the dice, and it named a gambling game played with them.
Crusaders brought the game to Europe, where Old French turned the name into hasard.
English players picked it up in the 1300s, and hazard was a dice game of chance where fortunes were lost on a single throw.
Gambling losses made chance feel like danger, so a game of luck slowly became any risk at all.
